1	package gateway
2	
3	import (
4		"bytes"
5		"context"
6		"encoding/json"
7		"io"
8		"log/slog"
9		"net/http"
10		"net/http/httputil"
11		"net/url"
12		"strings"
13		"sync"
14		"time"
15	
16		"github.com/nogo/wire/internal/anthropic"
17		"github.com/nogo/wire/internal/config"
18		"github.com/nogo/wire/internal/process"
19	)
20	
21	// backendManager is the subset of process.Manager the Gateway depends on.
22	type backendManager interface {
23		Addr(name string) (string, bool)
24		Healthy(name string) bool
25	}
26	
27	// Gateway is an HTTP reverse-proxy that routes OpenAI-compatible requests to backends.
28	type Gateway struct {
29		cfg    *config.Config
30		mgr    backendManager
31		log    *slog.Logger
32		rt     *routeTable
33		server *http.Server
34	}
35	
36	// New creates a Gateway backed by the given process manager.
37	func New(cfg *config.Config, mgr *process.Manager, log *slog.Logger) *Gateway {
38		return newGateway(cfg, mgr, log)
39	}
40	
41	func newGateway(cfg *config.Config, mgr backendManager, log *slog.Logger) *Gateway {
42		g := &Gateway{cfg: cfg, mgr: mgr, log: log, rt: buildRouteTable(cfg)}
43	
44		mux := http.NewServeMux()
45		mux.HandleFunc("POST /v1/chat/completions", g.handleRoute)
46		mux.HandleFunc("POST /v1/completions", g.handleRoute)
47		mux.HandleFunc("POST /v1/embeddings", g.handleRoute)
48		mux.HandleFunc("POST /v1/rerank", g.handleRoute)
49		mux.HandleFunc("GET /v1/models", g.handleModels)
50		mux.HandleFunc("GET /health", g.handleHealth)
51	
52		g.server = &http.Server{Addr: cfg.Listen, Handler: mux}
53		return g
54	}
55	
56	// ListenAndServe starts the HTTP server and shuts it down when ctx is cancelled.
57	func (g *Gateway) ListenAndServe(ctx context.Context) error {
58		errCh := make(chan error, 1)
59		go func() {
60			if err := g.server.ListenAndServe(); err != nil && err != http.ErrServerClosed {
61				errCh <- err
62			}
63		}()
64		select {
65		case err := <-errCh:
66			return err
67		case <-ctx.Done():
68			shutCtx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 10*time.Second)
69			defer cancel()
70			return g.server.Shutdown(shutCtx)
71		}
72	}
73	
74	// handleRoute extracts the model field from the JSON body and proxies to the matching backend.
75	func (g *Gateway) handleRoute(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
76		if len(g.cfg.Backends) == 0 {
77			writeError(w, http.StatusInternalServerError, "server_error", "no backends configured", "no_backends")
78			return
79		}
80	
81		// Tee the body so the decoder and the upstream both see it.
82		var captured bytes.Buffer
83		tee := io.TeeReader(r.Body, &captured)
84		dec := json.NewDecoder(tee)
85	
86		var payload struct {
87			Model string `json:"model"`
88		}
89		if err := dec.Decode(&payload); err != nil {
90			writeError(w, http.StatusBadRequest, "invalid_request_error", "invalid JSON: "+err.Error(), "bad_request")
91			return
92		}
93		if payload.Model == "" {
94			writeError(w, http.StatusBadRequest, "invalid_request_error", "missing model field", "bad_request")
95			return
96		}
97	
98		// Reconstruct full body: captured bytes (read by decoder) + rest not yet read.
99		r.Body = io.NopCloser(io.MultiReader(&captured, r.Body))
100	
101		backendName, err := g.rt.resolve(payload.Model)
102		if err != nil {
103			writeError(w, http.StatusBadRequest, "invalid_request_error", err.Error(), "model_not_found")
104			return
105		}
106	
107		if !g.mgr.Healthy(backendName) {
108			writeError(w, http.StatusServiceUnavailable, "server_error", "backend unavailable", "backend_unavailable")
109			return
110		}
111	
112		addr, ok := g.mgr.Addr(backendName)
113		if !ok {
114			writeError(w, http.StatusServiceUnavailable, "server_error", "backend unavailable", "backend_unavailable")
115			return
116		}
117	
118		backend := g.cfg.Backends[backendName]
119		if backend.Provider == "anthropic" {
120			g.handleAnthropicProxy(w, r, backendName, backend, addr)
121			return
122		}
123	
124		target, parseErr := url.Parse(addr)
125		if parseErr != nil {
126			writeError(w, http.StatusInternalServerError, "server_error", "invalid backend URL", "internal_error")
127			return
128		}
129	
130		rewriter := g.buildReplacer(backendName)
131	
132		proxy := &httputil.ReverseProxy{
133			Rewrite: func(pr *httputil.ProxyRequest) {
134				pr.SetURL(target)
135				pr.Out.Host = target.Host
136			},
137			FlushInterval: -1,
138			ModifyResponse: func(resp *http.Response) error {
139				if rewriter != nil {
140					resp.Header.Del("Content-Length")
141					resp.ContentLength = -1
142					resp.Body = io.NopCloser(&replacingReader{r: resp.Body, repl: rewriter})
143				}
144				return nil
145			},
146			ErrorHandler: func(w http.ResponseWriter, _ *http.Request, err error) {
147				g.log.Error("proxy error", "backend", backendName, "error", err)
148				writeError(w, http.StatusBadGateway, "server_error", "upstream error: "+err.Error(), "upstream_error")
149			},
150		}
151	
152		proxy.ServeHTTP(w, r)
153	}
154	
155	// handleAnthropicProxy translates the OpenAI-format request to Anthropic Messages API format,
156	// proxies it directly (without httputil.ReverseProxy), and translates the response back.
157	func (g *Gateway) handleAnthropicProxy(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request, backendName string, backend config.Backend, addr string) {
158		body, err := io.ReadAll(r.Body)
159		if err != nil {
160			writeError(w, http.StatusBadRequest, "invalid_request_error", "failed to read body", "bad_request")
161			return
162		}
163	
164		// Determine whether the client wants a streaming response.
165		var meta struct {
166			Stream bool `json:"stream"`
167		}
168		json.Unmarshal(body, &meta) //nolint:errcheck
169	
170		// model is either the configured model name (managed) or the backend name (external).
171		model := backend.Model
172		if model == "" {
173			model = backendName
174		}
175	
176		antBody, err := anthropic.TranslateRequest(body, model)
177		if err != nil {
178			writeError(w, http.StatusBadRequest, "invalid_request_error", "translation failed: "+err.Error(), "bad_request")
179			return
180		}
181	
182		antURL := strings.TrimRight(addr, "/") + "/v1/messages"
183		antReq, err := http.NewRequestWithContext(r.Context(), http.MethodPost, antURL, bytes.NewReader(antBody))
184		if err != nil {
185			writeError(w, http.StatusInternalServerError, "server_error", "failed to build upstream request", "internal_error")
186			return
187		}
188		antReq.Header.Set("content-type", "application/json")
189		antReq.Header.Set("x-api-key", backend.APIKey)
190		antReq.Header.Set("anthropic-version", "2023-06-01")
191	
192		resp, err := http.DefaultClient.Do(antReq)
193		if err != nil {
194			g.log.Error("anthropic upstream error", "backend", backendName, "error", err)
195			writeError(w, http.StatusBadGateway, "server_error", "upstream error: "+err.Error(), "upstream_error")
196			return
197		}
198		defer resp.Body.Close()
199	
200		if resp.StatusCode/100 != 2 {
201			var buf bytes.Buffer
202			buf.ReadFrom(resp.Body) //nolint:errcheck
203			writeError(w, resp.StatusCode, "server_error", "upstream: "+strings.TrimSpace(buf.String()), "upstream_error")
204			return
205		}
206	
207		if meta.Stream {
208			w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "text/event-stream")
209			w.Header().Set("Cache-Control", "no-cache")
210			w.Header().Set("Connection", "keep-alive")
211			anthropic.TranslateStream(resp.Body, w, backendName)
212			return
213		}
214	
215		var buf bytes.Buffer
216		buf.ReadFrom(resp.Body) //nolint:errcheck
217		translated, err := anthropic.TranslateResponse(buf.Bytes(), backendName)
218		if err != nil {
219			writeError(w, http.StatusInternalServerError, "server_error", "response translation failed: "+err.Error(), "internal_error")
220			return
221		}
222		w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
223		w.Write(translated) //nolint:errcheck
224	}
225	
226	// handleModels merges GET /v1/models from all backends and rewrites model IDs to backend names.
227	func (g *Gateway) handleModels(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
228		type modelObj struct {
229			ID      string `json:"id"`
230			Object  string `json:"object"`
231			Created int64  `json:"created"`
232			OwnedBy string `json:"owned_by"`
233		}
234		type modelsResp struct {
235			Object string     `json:"object"`
236			Data   []modelObj `json:"data"`
237		}
238	
239		var (
240			mu   sync.Mutex
241			data []modelObj
242			wg   sync.WaitGroup
243		)
244		now := time.Now().Unix()
245	
246		for name := range g.cfg.Backends {
247			name := name
248			wg.Add(1)
249			go func() {
250				defer wg.Done()
251				fallback := modelObj{ID: name, Object: "model", Created: now, OwnedBy: "wire"}
252	
253				addr, ok := g.mgr.Addr(name)
254				if !ok {
255					mu.Lock()
256					data = append(data, fallback)
257					mu.Unlock()
258					return
259				}
260	
261				ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(r.Context(), 5*time.Second)
262				defer cancel()
263	
264				req, err := http.NewRequestWithContext(ctx, http.MethodGet, addr+"/v1/models", nil)
265				if err != nil {
266					mu.Lock()
267					data = append(data, fallback)
268					mu.Unlock()
269					return
270				}
271	
272				resp, err := http.DefaultClient.Do(req)
273				if err != nil {
274					mu.Lock()
275					data = append(data, fallback)
276					mu.Unlock()
277					return
278				}
279				defer resp.Body.Close()
280	
281				var mr modelsResp
282				if err := json.NewDecoder(resp.Body).Decode(&mr); err != nil || len(mr.Data) == 0 {
283					mu.Lock()
284					data = append(data, fallback)
285					mu.Unlock()
286					return
287				}
288	
289				entry := mr.Data[0]
290				entry.ID = name
291				mu.Lock()
292				data = append(data, entry)
293				mu.Unlock()
294			}()
295		}
296		wg.Wait()
297	
298		w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
299		json.NewEncoder(w).Encode(modelsResp{Object: "list", Data: data}) //nolint:errcheck
300	}
301	
302	// handleHealth returns 200 if at least one backend is healthy, 503 otherwise.
303	func (g *Gateway) handleHealth(w http.ResponseWriter, _ *http.Request) {
304		w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
305		for name := range g.cfg.Backends {
306			if g.mgr.Healthy(name) {
307				w.WriteHeader(http.StatusOK)
308				json.NewEncoder(w).Encode(map[string]string{"status": "ok"}) //nolint:errcheck
309				return
310			}
311		}
312		w.WriteHeader(http.StatusServiceUnavailable)
313		json.NewEncoder(w).Encode(map[string]string{"status": "degraded"}) //nolint:errcheck
314	}
315	
316	// buildReplacer creates a strings.Replacer that rewrites llama-server model name aliases
317	// in response bodies to the canonical backend name.
318	func (g *Gateway) buildReplacer(backendName string) *strings.Replacer {
319		aliases := g.rt.backendAliases[backendName]
320		var pairs []string
321		for _, alias := range aliases {
322			if alias == backendName {
323				continue
324			}
325			pairs = append(pairs,
326				`"model":"`+alias+`"`, `"model":"`+backendName+`"`,
327			)
328		}
329		if len(pairs) == 0 {
330			return nil
331		}
332		return strings.NewReplacer(pairs...)
333	}
334	
335	// replacingReader wraps an io.Reader and applies a strings.Replacer to each chunk read.
336	// Overflow bytes (when replacement expands the chunk) are buffered internally.
337	type replacingReader struct {
338		r    io.Reader
339		repl *strings.Replacer
340		buf  bytes.Buffer
341	}
342	
343	func (rr *replacingReader) Read(p []byte) (int, error) {
344		if rr.buf.Len() > 0 {
345			return rr.buf.Read(p)
346		}
347		tmp := make([]byte, len(p))
348		n, readErr := rr.r.Read(tmp)
349		if n > 0 {
350			replaced := []byte(rr.repl.Replace(string(tmp[:n])))
351			copy(p, replaced)
352			if len(replaced) > len(p) {
353				rr.buf.Write(replaced[len(p):])
354				return len(p), nil // defer readErr until buf is drained
355			}
356			return len(replaced), readErr
357		}
358		return 0, readErr
359	}
360	
361	// writeError writes an OpenAI-format JSON error response.
362	func writeError(w http.ResponseWriter, status int, errType, message, code string) {
363		w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
364		w.WriteHeader(status)
365		json.NewEncoder(w).Encode(map[string]any{ //nolint:errcheck
366			"error": map[string]any{
367				"message": message,
368				"type":    errType,
369				"code":    code,
370			},
371		})
372	}
373

1	package provider
2	
3	import (
4		"encoding/json"
5	
6		"forge/internal/domain"
7	)
8	
9	// Message is a single turn in a conversation.
10	type Message struct {
11		Role    domain.MessageRole
12		Content []ContentBlock
13	}
14	
15	// TextMessage is a convenience constructor for a simple text message.
16	func TextMessage(role domain.MessageRole, text string) Message {
17		return Message{Role: role, Content: []ContentBlock{{Type: "text", Text: text}}}
18	}
19	
20	// ContentBlock is one element within a message.
21	// Type is one of: "text", "tool_use", "tool_result".
22	type ContentBlock struct {
23		Type string // "text" | "tool_use" | "tool_result"
24	
25		// For type "text"
26		Text string
27	
28		// For type "tool_use" (assistant calling a tool)
29		ID    string          // tool call ID
30		Name  string          // tool name
31		Input json.RawMessage // tool arguments, JSON object
32	
33		// For type "tool_result" (user returning tool output)
34		// ID references the tool_use ID.
35		Content string // tool result content
36		IsError bool   // true if the tool returned an error
37	}
38	
39	// Tool is a tool definition that can be passed to the LLM.
40	type Tool struct {
41		Name        string
42		Description string
43		InputSchema json.RawMessage // JSON Schema object describing the input
44	}
45	
46	// DeltaType classifies a streaming event.
47	type DeltaType string
48	
49	const (
50		DeltaTypeText         DeltaType = "text"
51		DeltaTypeToolUseStart DeltaType = "tool_use_start"
52		DeltaTypeToolUseDelta DeltaType = "tool_use_delta"
53		DeltaTypeToolUseEnd   DeltaType = "tool_use_end"
54		DeltaTypeUsage        DeltaType = "usage"
55		DeltaTypeError        DeltaType = "error"
56		DeltaTypeDone         DeltaType = "done"
57	)
58	
59	// Delta is a single streaming event from a provider.
60	//
61	// Text event: Type=DeltaTypeText, Text contains the chunk.
62	// ToolUseStart: Type=DeltaTypeToolUseStart, ID+Name set.
63	// ToolUseDelta: Type=DeltaTypeToolUseDelta, ID set, Input contains JSON fragment.
64	// ToolUseEnd: Type=DeltaTypeToolUseEnd, ID set, Input contains full accumulated JSON.
65	// Usage: Type=DeltaTypeUsage, Usage set.
66	// Error: Type=DeltaTypeError, Err set.
67	// Done: Type=DeltaTypeDone — final event, always sent.
68	type Delta struct {
69		Type  DeltaType
70		Text  string        // DeltaTypeText
71		ID    string        // DeltaTypeToolUseStart/Delta/End
72		Name  string        // DeltaTypeToolUseStart
73		Input string        // DeltaTypeToolUseDelta (fragment) and DeltaTypeToolUseEnd (full)
74		Usage *domain.Usage // DeltaTypeUsage — populated on final usage event
75		Err   error         // DeltaTypeError
76	}
77	
78	// Capability identifies a feature a provider supports.
79	type Capability string
80	
81	const (
82		// CapForgeLoop: Forge dispatches tool calls — provider emits tool_use blocks,
83		// Forge executes them and returns tool_result. Required for validator, discovery,
84		// extractor, consolidator roles.
85		CapForgeLoop Capability = "forge_loop"
86	
87		// CapAgentLoop: Agent runs its own tool loop (bash, read, write, git).
88		// Forge sends prompt and observes. Incompatible with roles that need Forge tools.
89		CapAgentLoop Capability = "agent_loop"
90	
91		// CapCwd: Provider accepts a working directory per request (req.WorkDir).
92		// Required for agent-loop executor to operate in the project workspace.
93		CapCwd Capability = "cwd"
94	
95		// CapSystemPrompt: Provider accepts req.System as a dedicated system prompt,
96		// not prepended to the first user message.
97		CapSystemPrompt Capability = "system_prompt"
98	)
99	
100	// Capabilities is the set of capabilities a provider declares.
101	type Capabilities []Capability
102	
103	// Has reports whether the capability set includes cap.
104	func (c Capabilities) Has(cap Capability) bool {
105		for _, v := range c {
106			if v == cap {
107				return true
108			}
109		}
110		return false
111	}
112	
113	// Request is the full input to a provider call.
114	type Request struct {
115		Model     string
116		System    string
117		Messages  []Message
118		Tools     []Tool
119		MaxTokens int    // 0 means provider default
120		WorkDir   string // working directory for agent-loop providers; empty = inherit
121	}
122	
123	// StopReason describes why the model stopped.
124	type StopReason string
125	
126	const (
127		StopReasonEndTurn   StopReason = "end_turn"
128		StopReasonToolUse   StopReason = "tool_use"
129		StopReasonMaxTokens StopReason = "max_tokens"
130	)

Configuration management for Wire with these components:
- `Config` struct with listen address, backends mapping, and peer list

## 3. /home/nogo/Development/projects/forge/delta/internal/provider/anthropic/anthropic.go
Anthropic Messages API client implementing the provider.Provider interface:

- Supports streaming with SSE parsing

- Computes token costs

OpenAI-compatible API client implementing the provider.Provider interface:

- Implements capabilities: ForgeLoop and SystemPrompt

1	package gateway
2	
3	import (
4		"bytes"
5		"context"
6		"encoding/json"
7		"io"
8		"log/slog"
9		"net/http"
10		"net/http/httputil"
11		"net/url"
12		"strings"
13		"sync"
14		"time"
15	
16		"github.com/nogo/wire/internal/anthropic"
17		"github.com/nogo/wire/internal/config"
18		"github.com/nogo/wire/internal/process"
19	)
20	
21	// backendManager is the subset of process.Manager the Gateway depends on.
22	type backendManager interface {
23		Addr(name string) (string, bool)
24		Healthy(name string) bool
25	}
26	
27	// Gateway is an HTTP reverse-proxy that routes OpenAI-compatible requests to backends.
28	type Gateway struct {
29		cfg    *config.Config
30		mgr    backendManager
31		log    *slog.Logger
32		rt     *routeTable
33		server *http.Server
34	}
35	
36	// New creates a Gateway backed by the given process manager.
37	func New(cfg *config.Config, mgr *process.Manager, log *slog.Logger) *Gateway {
38		return newGateway(cfg, mgr, log)
39	}
40	
41	func newGateway(cfg *config.Config, mgr backendManager, log *slog.Logger) *Gateway {
42		g := &Gateway{cfg: cfg, mgr: mgr, log: log, rt: buildRouteTable(cfg)}
43	
44		mux := http.NewServeMux()
45		mux.HandleFunc("POST /v1/chat/completions", g.handleRoute)
46		mux.HandleFunc("POST /v1/completions", g.handleRoute)
47		mux.HandleFunc("POST /v1/embeddings", g.handleRoute)
48		mux.HandleFunc("POST /v1/rerank", g.handleRoute)
49		mux.HandleFunc("GET /v1/models", g.handleModels)
50		mux.HandleFunc("GET /health", g.handleHealth)
51	
52		g.server = &http.Server{Addr: cfg.Listen, Handler: mux}
53		return g
54	}
55	
56	// ListenAndServe starts the HTTP server and shuts it down when ctx is cancelled.
57	func (g *Gateway) ListenAndServe(ctx context.Context) error {
58		errCh := make(chan error, 1)
59		go func() {
60			if err := g.server.ListenAndServe(); err != nil && err != http.ErrServerClosed {
61				errCh <- err
62			}
63		}()
64		select {
65		case err := <-errCh:
66			return err
67		case <-ctx.Done():
68			shutCtx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 10*time.Second)
69			defer cancel()
70			return g.server.Shutdown(shutCtx)
71		}
72	}
73	
74	// handleRoute extracts the model field from the JSON body and proxies to the matching backend.
75	func (g *Gateway) handleRoute(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
76		if len(g.cfg.Backends) == 0 {
77			writeError(w, http.StatusInternalServerError, "server_error", "no backends configured", "no_backends")
78			return
79		}
80	
81		// Tee the body so the decoder and the upstream both see it.
82		var captured bytes.Buffer
83		tee := io.TeeReader(r.Body, &captured)
84		dec := json.NewDecoder(tee)
85	
86		var payload struct {
87			Model string `json:"model"`
88		}
89		if err := dec.Decode(&payload); err != nil {
90			writeError(w, http.StatusBadRequest, "invalid_request_error", "invalid JSON: "+err.Error(), "bad_request")
91			return
92		}
93		if payload.Model == "" {
94			writeError(w, http.StatusBadRequest, "invalid_request_error", "missing model field", "bad_request")
95			return
96		}
97	
98		// Reconstruct full body: captured bytes (read by decoder) + rest not yet read.
99		r.Body = io.NopCloser(io.MultiReader(&captured, r.Body))
100	
101		backendName, err := g.rt.resolve(payload.Model)
102		if err != nil {
103			writeError(w, http.StatusBadRequest, "invalid_request_error", err.Error(), "model_not_found")
104			return
105		}
106	
107		if !g.mgr.Healthy(backendName) {
108			writeError(w, http.StatusServiceUnavailable, "server_error", "backend unavailable", "backend_unavailable")
109			return
110		}
111	
112		addr, ok := g.mgr.Addr(backendName)
113		if !ok {
114			writeError(w, http.StatusServiceUnavailable, "server_error", "backend unavailable", "backend_unavailable")
115			return
116		}
117	
118		backend := g.cfg.Backends[backendName]
119		if backend.Provider == "anthropic" {
120			g.handleAnthropicProxy(w, r, backendName, backend, addr)
121			return
122		}
123	
124		target, parseErr := url.Parse(addr)
125		if parseErr != nil {
126			writeError(w, http.StatusInternalServerError, "server_error", "invalid backend URL", "internal_error")
127			return
128		}
129	
130		rewriter := g.buildReplacer(backendName)
131	
132		proxy := &httputil.ReverseProxy{
133			Rewrite: func(pr *httputil.ProxyRequest) {
134				pr.SetURL(target)
135				pr.Out.Host = target.Host
136			},
137			FlushInterval: -1,
138			ModifyResponse: func(resp *http.Response) error {
139				if rewriter != nil {
140					resp.Header.Del("Content-Length")
141					resp.ContentLength = -1
142					resp.Body = io.NopCloser(&replacingReader{r: resp.Body, repl: rewriter})
143				}
144				return nil
145			},
146			ErrorHandler: func(w http.ResponseWriter, _ *http.Request, err error) {
147				g.log.Error("proxy error", "backend", backendName, "error", err)
148				writeError(w, http.StatusBadGateway, "server_error", "upstream error: "+err.Error(), "upstream_error")
149			},
150		}
151	
152		proxy.ServeHTTP(w, r)
153	}
154	
155	// handleAnthropicProxy translates the OpenAI-format request to Anthropic Messages API format,
156	// proxies it directly (without httputil.ReverseProxy), and translates the response back.
157	func (g *Gateway) handleAnthropicProxy(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request, backendName string, backend config.Backend, addr string) {
158		body, err := io.ReadAll(r.Body)
159		if err != nil {
160			writeError(w, http.StatusBadRequest, "invalid_request_error", "failed to read body", "bad_request")
161			return
162		}
163	
164		// Determine whether the client wants a streaming response.
165		var meta struct {
166			Stream bool `json:"stream"`
167		}
168		json.Unmarshal(body, &meta) //nolint:errcheck
169	
170		// model is either the configured model name (managed) or the backend name (external).
171		model := backend.Model
172		if model == "" {
173			model = backendName
174		}
175	
176		antBody, err := anthropic.TranslateRequest(body, model)
177		if err != nil {
178			writeError(w, http.StatusBadRequest, "invalid_request_error", "translation failed: "+err.Error(), "bad_request")
179			return
180		}
181	
182		antURL := strings.TrimRight(addr, "/") + "/v1/messages"
183		antReq, err := http.NewRequestWithContext(r.Context(), http.MethodPost, antURL, bytes.NewReader(antBody))
184		if err != nil {
185			writeError(w, http.StatusInternalServerError, "server_error", "failed to build upstream request", "internal_error")
186			return
187		}
188		antReq.Header.Set("content-type", "application/json")
189		antReq.Header.Set("x-api-key", backend.APIKey)
190		antReq.Header.Set("anthropic-version", "2023-06-01")
191	
192		resp, err := http.DefaultClient.Do(antReq)
193		if err != nil {
194			g.log.Error("anthropic upstream error", "backend", backendName, "error", err)
195			writeError(w, http.StatusBadGateway, "server_error", "upstream error: "+err.Error(), "upstream_error")
196			return
197		}
198		defer resp.Body.Close()
199	
200		if resp.StatusCode/100 != 2 {
201			var buf bytes.Buffer
202			buf.ReadFrom(resp.Body) //nolint:errcheck
203			writeError(w, resp.StatusCode, "server_error", "upstream: "+strings.TrimSpace(buf.String()), "upstream_error")
204			return
205		}
206	
207		if meta.Stream {
208			w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "text/event-stream")
209			w.Header().Set("Cache-Control", "no-cache")
210			w.Header().Set("Connection", "keep-alive")
211			anthropic.TranslateStream(resp.Body, w, backendName)
212			return
213		}
214	
215		var buf bytes.Buffer
216		buf.ReadFrom(resp.Body) //nolint:errcheck
217		translated, err := anthropic.TranslateResponse(buf.Bytes(), backendName)
218		if err != nil {
219			writeError(w, http.StatusInternalServerError, "server_error", "response translation failed: "+err.Error(), "internal_error")
220			return
221		}
222		w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
223		w.Write(translated) //nolint:errcheck
224	}
225	
226	// handleModels merges GET /v1/models from all backends and rewrites model IDs to backend names.
227	func (g *Gateway) handleModels(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
228		type modelObj struct {
229			ID      string `json:"id"`
230			Object  string `json:"object"`
231			Created int64  `json:"created"`
232			OwnedBy string `json:"owned_by"`
233		}
234		type modelsResp struct {
235			Object string     `json:"object"`
236			Data   []modelObj `json:"data"`
237		}
238	
239		var (
240			mu   sync.Mutex
241			data []modelObj
242			wg   sync.WaitGroup
243		)
244		now := time.Now().Unix()
245	
246		for name := range g.cfg.Backends {
247			name := name
248			wg.Add(1)
249			go func() {
250				defer wg.Done()
251				fallback := modelObj{ID: name, Object: "model", Created: now, OwnedBy: "wire"}
252	
253				addr, ok := g.mgr.Addr(name)
254				if !ok {
255					mu.Lock()
256					data = append(data, fallback)
257					mu.Unlock()
258					return
259				}
260	
261				ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(r.Context(), 5*time.Second)
262				defer cancel()
263	
264				req, err := http.NewRequestWithContext(ctx, http.MethodGet, addr+"/v1/models", nil)
265				if err != nil {
266					mu.Lock()
267					data = append(data, fallback)
268					mu.Unlock()
269					return
270				}
271	
272				resp, err := http.DefaultClient.Do(req)
273				if err != nil {
274					mu.Lock()
275					data = append(data, fallback)
276					mu.Unlock()
277					return
278				}
279				defer resp.Body.Close()
280	
281				var mr modelsResp
282				if err := json.NewDecoder(resp.Body).Decode(&mr); err != nil || len(mr.Data) == 0 {
283					mu.Lock()
284					data = append(data, fallback)
285					mu.Unlock()
286					return
287				}
288	
289				entry := mr.Data[0]
290				entry.ID = name
291				mu.Lock()
292				data = append(data, entry)
293				mu.Unlock()
294			}()
295		}
296		wg.Wait()
297	
298		w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
299		json.NewEncoder(w).Encode(modelsResp{Object: "list", Data: data}) //nolint:errcheck
300	}
301	
302	// handleHealth returns 200 if at least one backend is healthy, 503 otherwise.
303	func (g *Gateway) handleHealth(w http.ResponseWriter, _ *http.Request) {
304		w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
305		for name := range g.cfg.Backends {
306			if g.mgr.Healthy(name) {
307				w.WriteHeader(http.StatusOK)
308				json.NewEncoder(w).Encode(map[string]string{"status": "ok"}) //nolint:errcheck
309				return
310			}
311		}
312		w.WriteHeader(http.StatusServiceUnavailable)
313		json.NewEncoder(w).Encode(map[string]string{"status": "degraded"}) //nolint:errcheck
314	}
315	
316	// buildReplacer creates a strings.Replacer that rewrites llama-server model name aliases
317	// in response bodies to the canonical backend name.
318	func (g *Gateway) buildReplacer(backendName string) *strings.Replacer {
319		aliases := g.rt.backendAliases[backendName]
320		var pairs []string
321		for _, alias := range aliases {
322			if alias == backendName {
323				continue
324			}
325			pairs = append(pairs,
326				`"model":"`+alias+`"`, `"model":"`+backendName+`"`,
327			)
328		}
329		if len(pairs) == 0 {
330			return nil
331		}
332		return strings.NewReplacer(pairs...)
333	}
334	
335	// replacingReader wraps an io.Reader and applies a strings.Replacer to each chunk read.
336	// Overflow bytes (when replacement expands the chunk) are buffered internally.
337	type replacingReader struct {
338		r    io.Reader
339		repl *strings.Replacer
340		buf  bytes.Buffer
341	}
342	
343	func (rr *replacingReader) Read(p []byte) (int, error) {
344		if rr.buf.Len() > 0 {
345			return rr.buf.Read(p)
346		}
347		tmp := make([]byte, len(p))
348		n, readErr := rr.r.Read(tmp)
349		if n > 0 {
350			replaced := []byte(rr.repl.Replace(string(tmp[:n])))
351			copy(p, replaced)
352			if len(replaced) > len(p) {
353				rr.buf.Write(replaced[len(p):])
354				return len(p), nil // defer readErr until buf is drained
355			}
356			return len(replaced), readErr
357		}
358		return 0, readErr
359	}
360	
361	// writeError writes an OpenAI-format JSON error response.
362	func writeError(w http.ResponseWriter, status int, errType, message, code string) {
363		w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
364		w.WriteHeader(status)
365		json.NewEncoder(w).Encode(map[string]any{ //nolint:errcheck
366			"error": map[string]any{
367				"message": message,
368				"type":    errType,
369				"code":    code,
370			},
371		})
372	}
